what: A centered looping carousel that runs only on narrow screens (1099px and under by default) — each slide is cloned two at the front and two at the back so the current slide sits dead center. Prev/next buttons, dots, and finger swipes (over 50px) move one slide at a time with .3s ease. Reaching a clone jumps with no transition to the identical real slide, so it never ends. While dragging, it follows the finger as is, and on wide screens the clones are removed and the slides sit side by side (review board: three cards in a row on wide screens, one at a time on phones)

options.below: Runs as a carousel only at this width (px) or below, default 1099 — 0 means always
options.clone: Number of cells to clone front and back, default 2
options.dur: Duration of one step forward (sec), default .3 — 0 means instant
options.swipe: Finger swipe distance (px) counted as a flip, default 50
options.[data-fx-part=track]: Row holding the cells (children are cells)
options.[data-fx-part=ctrl]: (if any) control row shown only for carousels — leave it hidden and the motion part turns it on
options.[data-fx-part=dots]: (if present) empty list to fill with dots — is-active on the current dot
